svg.title: Request flow: host to client to server and back
svg.desc: An MCP round trip. The host's model produces a tool call, the client carries it across the protocol to the server, and the server runs the tool and returns the result the same way. The server's catalog of tools, each with a JSON Schema, constrains what a valid call looks like.
svg.text: // REQUEST FLOW: HOST TOCLIENT TO SERVER AND BACK
